prompt: Karan's dog wouldn't have jumped into the water if he (to hold) the lead.
explanation_ru: Речь о нереальном прошлом: пёс уже прыгнул в воду. В придаточном с if для прошедшего условия нужен Past Perfect (had held).

prompt: If I had walked in those cheap shoes first, I (not / to buy) them.
explanation_ru: Покупка уже состоялась в прошлом, и говорящий о ней жалеет. В главной части третьего типа используется wouldn't have + V3.

prompt: If Ursula (to book) near the lift, she wouldn't have climbed three floors.
explanation_ru: Урсула уже поднялась по лестнице, ситуация относится к прошлому. После if в третьем типе ставится Past Perfect (had booked).

prompt:
— Why did Chiara's bread come out so flat and heavy?
— It (to rise) properly if she (not / to forget) the yeast.
explanation_ru: Хлеб уже испечён, поэтому обсуждается нереальная причина в прошлом. В результате ставим would have risen, а в условии после if — hadn't forgotten.

prompt: At the concert in Cairo, (Nadia / to hear) the last song if she (to wait) ten more minutes?
explanation_ru: В вопросе третьего типа глагол would (или could) выносится перед подлежащим, а have + V3 остаётся после него. В придаточном с if используется Past Perfect.

prompt: Grzegorz (not / to use) that strong spray on his farm if someone (to warn) him about the bees.
explanation_ru: Поле уже обработано, изменить прошлое нельзя. Главная часть строится с wouldn't have + V3, а условие после if — с had + V3.

prompt: Tamir didn't stop to think before replying; if he (to stay) quiet, he (not / to lose) a good friend.
explanation_ru: Первая часть предложения показывает реальный факт в прошлом. Для воображаемого прошлого результата нужны had stayed и wouldn't have lost.

prompt: If Regula (to notice) how directly the afternoon sun hit the table by the window, she (to move) the old map before its colours faded.
explanation_ru: Краски на карте уже выцвели, поэтому условие и результат относятся к завершённому прошлому. В условии требуется Past Perfect, а в главной части — would have + V3.

prompt: Even after the cold night in Namibia froze the big telescope, Alicia wondered what clear pictures the team (to take) if the heater (to work) properly.
explanation_ru: Телескоп замёрз в прошлом, и Алисия размышляет об упущенной возможности. Для предполагаемого прошлого результата подходит would/could/might have taken, а после if — had worked.

prompt: I usually check the weather app before leaving my flat in Busan, but I rushed out in a hurry. If I (to open) the app, I would have seen the storm warning. I (not / to spend) the whole morning in wet shoes if I had worn my boots. Honestly, (you / to go) out in a thin shirt if you had seen those clouds? Luckily, a colleague lent me a dry jumper.
explanation_ru: Вся история описывает прошедшее утро и сожаление о нём. В условии после if нужен Past Perfect (had opened), в отрицательном результате — wouldn't have spent, а в вопросе — would you have gone.

prompt: Danielle sent a marketing email to hundreds of customers without checking the product name. If she (not / to rush) the message, she (to find) the spelling mistake on the first line. (her boss / to see) the error if Danielle had sent him a draft first? In the end, the office had to write a second email to apologise.
explanation_ru: Письмо с ошибкой уже ушло клиентам. В отрицательном условии ставим hadn't rushed, в результате — would/could have found, а в вопросе выносим Would или Could перед подлежащим.

prompt:
— How did your trial shift at the hotel kitchen in Palermo go, Heather?
— Badly! My bus broke down, so I arrived twenty minutes late. If the bus (to run) on time, I (to meet) the head chef before the lunch rush. I (not / to feel) so nervous during the whole afternoon either.
explanation_ru: Пробная смена уже закончилась, и Хезер представляет другой сценарий. После if нужен Past Perfect (had run), а в обоих результатах — would have met и wouldn't have felt.

prompt: Sana came second in the table tennis tournament in Karachi after missing her final serve. Everyone in the hall went quiet as the ball hit the net. If she (not / to hit) it so hard, she (to win) the match on that very point. Who knows what (to happen) if the referee had called a replay? Still, her coach told her she played brilliantly.
explanation_ru: Турнир уже завершился, и Сана мысленно переигрывает последний розыгрыш. В условии используется hadn't hit, а в обоих предполагаемых результатах — would/could/might have + V3.

prompt: During Tuesday's history exam in Kraków, a faulty sensor set off the fire alarm and forced all pupils outside. If the alarm (not / to ring) halfway through the paper, Zofia and her class (to finish) the test as planned. The school (not / to end) the session early if the fire crew had cleared the building sooner. A new date for the exam will appear on the noticeboard shortly.
explanation_ru: Экзамен во вторник уже сорвался из-за сигнализации. В придаточном условия нужна третья форма неправильного глагола (hadn't rung), а в главных частях — would have finished и wouldn't have ended.

prompt: Last week a thief broke into the back room of my small shop in Wonju. The repairman had warned me about the loose lock, but I kept putting the job off. If I (to pay) him to fix the door straight away, nobody (to break) in that night. Looking back, (I / to listen) to his advice if I had known how weak the lock really was? It was an expensive lesson to learn.
explanation_ru: Кража уже произошла на прошлой неделе. После if ставим had paid, с подлежащим nobody — утвердительную форму would/could have broken, а в вопросе — would I have listened.

prompt: Sepp ___ the old chair if his granddaughter had asked earlier.
options: wouldn't give away
wouldn't have given away
wouldn't had given away
hadn't given away
explanation_ru: Для нереального результата в прошлом нужна форма wouldn't have + V3. Типичная ошибка — ставить would had вместо would have или брать второй тип.

prompt: If Lior ___ in Tel Aviv over the weekend, he would have seen the street festival.
options: would have stayed
stayed
had stayed
has stayed
explanation_ru: В придаточном с if для прошлого условия нужен Past Perfect (had stayed). Частая ошибка русскоязычных — переводить «если бы» как if + would have.

prompt: Freya could have heard the talk about the Viking boat if she ___ it was starting.
options: had known
had knew
would have known
would know
explanation_ru: После had требуется третья форма глагола (known), а не вторая (knew). Также после if нельзя употреблять would.

prompt: After forgetting her line on the film set in Wuxi, the young actor realised she ___ a second try if she'd simply asked the director.
options: might get
had got
might had got
might have got
explanation_ru: Сокращение she'd перед V3 (asked) означает she had, то есть условие относится к прошлому. В результате после модального глагола всегда идёт have + V3, а не had.

prompt: If Miko would have stayed at the Tokyo exhibition, she would have met the artist.
answer: If Miko had stayed at the Tokyo exhibition, she would have met the artist.
accepted_answers: If Miko had stayed at the Tokyo exhibition, she would have met the artist.
If Miko'd stayed at the Tokyo exhibition, she would have met the artist.
If Miko had stayed at the Tokyo exhibition, she'd have met the artist.
explanation_ru: Ошибка — would have в части с if (калька с русского «если бы»). В условии третьего типа нужен Past Perfect: If Miko had stayed.

prompt: I would have reached the TV studio on time if I had took the earlier train.
answer: I would have reached the TV studio on time if I had taken the earlier train.
accepted_answers: I would have reached the TV studio on time if I had taken the earlier train.
I'd have reached the TV studio on time if I had taken the earlier train.
I would have reached the TV studio on time if I'd taken the earlier train.
I'd have reached the TV studio on time if I'd taken the earlier train.
explanation_ru: Ошибка — вторая форма глагола после had (had took). В Past Perfect нужна третья форма: had taken.

prompt: We'd have caught him at the red light if the traffic hadn't blocked our car.
answer: We'd have caught him at the red light if the traffic hadn't blocked our car.
accepted_answers: We'd have caught him at the red light if the traffic hadn't blocked our car.
We would have caught him at the red light if the traffic hadn't blocked our car.
We'd have caught him at the red light if the traffic had not blocked our car.
We would have caught him at the red light if the traffic had not blocked our car.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: We'd have caught (= We would have caught) правильно сочетается с hadn't blocked в третьем типе условных предложений.

prompt: Alessandra says she would had enjoyed the street festival in Bamako last year if she hadn't decided to keep her shop open.
answer: Alessandra says she would have enjoyed the street festival in Bamako last year if she hadn't decided to keep her shop open.
accepted_answers: Alessandra says she would have enjoyed the street festival in Bamako last year if she hadn't decided to keep her shop open.
Alessandra says she'd have enjoyed the street festival in Bamako last year if she hadn't decided to keep her shop open.
Alessandra says she would have enjoyed the street festival in Bamako last year if she had not decided to keep her shop open.
explanation_ru: Ошибка — would had вместо would have. После модального глагола would всегда используется инфинитив have, а не форма прошедшего времени had.

prompt: Jennifer sold her old telescope a month before a bright comet passed over Szeged, so she missed it.
options: If Jennifer didn't sell her telescope, she would see the comet.
If Jennifer hadn't sold her telescope, she could have seen the comet.
If Jennifer had sold her telescope, she could have seen the comet.
If Jennifer hadn't sold her telescope, she would have missed the comet.
explanation_ru: События уже в прошлом, поэтому нужен третий тип с противоположной полярностью: она продала телескоп (hadn't sold) и пропустила комету (could have seen).

prompt: Marek gave up cycling races as a teenager in Gdansk and took an office job instead, so he never rode in the big mountain races.
options: If Marek had stayed in his office job, he might have raced in the mountains.
If Marek didn't give up cycling, he might have raced in the mountains.
If Marek would have kept cycling, he might have raced in the mountains.
If Marek hadn't given up cycling, he might have raced in the mountains.
explanation_ru: Подходит только четвёртый вариант: Past Perfect в отрицательном условии (hadn't given up) и might have + V3 для возможного результата в прошлом.

prompt: Mei opened her tea shop near the school, so parents visited. → If Mei hadn't …
answer: If Mei hadn't opened her tea shop near the school, parents wouldn't have visited.
accepted_answers: If Mei hadn't opened her tea shop near the school, parents wouldn't have visited.
If Mei had not opened her tea shop near the school, parents would not have visited.
If Mei hadn't opened her tea shop near the school, parents would not have visited.
If Mei had not opened her tea shop near the school, parents wouldn't have visited.
If Mei hadn't opened her tea shop near the school, parents might not have visited.
explanation_ru: Оба реальных факта в прошлом были утвердительными, поэтому в нереальном условии третьего типа обе части становятся отрицательными: hadn't opened → wouldn't have visited.

prompt: I rented a cheap room far from college, so I spent hours on buses last term. → I wouldn't have …
answer: I wouldn't have spent hours on buses last term if I hadn't rented a cheap room far from college.
accepted_answers: I wouldn't have spent hours on buses last term if I hadn't rented a cheap room far from college.
I would not have spent hours on buses last term if I had not rented a cheap room far from college.
I wouldn't have spent hours on buses last term if I had not rented a cheap room far from college.
I would not have spent hours on buses last term if I hadn't rented a cheap room far from college.
I wouldn't have spent hours on buses last term if I had rented a room closer to college.
I would not have spent hours on buses last term if I had rented a room closer to college.
explanation_ru: Меняем оба прошлых факта на противоположные: главная часть идёт первой с wouldn't have spent, а после if ставится hadn't rented.

prompt: Reza stopped attending the art class in Burgas after one rude comment, so he never finished his final painting. → If Reza …
answer: If Reza hadn't stopped attending the art class in Burgas after one rude comment, he would have finished his final painting.
accepted_answers: If Reza hadn't stopped attending the art class in Burgas after one rude comment, he would have finished his final painting.
If Reza had not stopped attending the art class in Burgas after one rude comment, he would have finished his final painting.
If Reza hadn't stopped attending the art class in Burgas after one rude comment, he'd have finished his final painting.
If Reza hadn't stopped attending the art class in Burgas after one rude comment, he could have finished his final painting.
If Reza hadn't stopped attending the art class in Burgas after one rude comment, he might have finished his final painting.
explanation_ru: Условие «бросил занятия» переходит в отрицательный Past Perfect (hadn't stopped), а результат «не закончил картину» — в утвердительное would/could/might have finished.

prompt: If Henry had moved away, he wouldn't have come to our party.
options: Henry moved away and came to our party.
Henry did not move away and came to our party.
Henry did not move away and missed our party.
Henry does not move away and comes to our party.
explanation_ru: Третий тип переворачивает факты прошлого на противоположные: had moved away значит, что он не уехал, а wouldn't have come значит, что он пришёл.

prompt: If Ifeoma had studied pharmacy instead, she wouldn't have opened her friendly dental clinic in Miskolc.
options: Ifeoma studied pharmacy and opened a dental clinic in Miskolc.
Ifeoma did not study pharmacy and never opened a dental clinic in Miskolc.
Ifeoma did not study pharmacy, and she opened her dental clinic in Miskolc.
Ifeoma is studying pharmacy, so she will not open a dental clinic.
explanation_ru: В реальном прошлом всё наоборот: Ифеома не стала учиться на фармацевта и открыла свою стоматологическую клинику.

prompt: Alma couldn't have built her first phone app if she hadn't left banking three years ago.
options: Alma left banking three years ago and built her first phone app.
Alma stayed in banking three years ago and built her first phone app.
Alma left banking three years ago, so she failed to build her first phone app.
Alma wants to leave banking so that she can build a phone app.
explanation_ru: Обе части предложения отрицательные, поэтому в действительности в прошлом оба события произошли: Альма ушла из банка и создала приложение.

prompt: Ingrid wouldn't have panicked in Bergen's busy centre if she'd learned to drive on city roads.
options: Ingrid learned to drive on city roads and did not panic in Bergen.
Ingrid learned to drive on city roads, but she panicked in Bergen.
Ingrid did not learn to drive on city roads, and she stayed calm in Bergen.
Ingrid did not learn to drive on city roads, and she panicked in Bergen.
explanation_ru: She'd learned = she had learned (на деле она не училась на городских дорогах), а wouldn't have panicked означает, что в реальности она запаниковала.

prompt: I'd have ended up in a noisy city flat if I hadn't accepted the weather-station job on this windy Swedish island.
options: I turned down the island job and moved into a noisy city flat.
I accepted the island job and avoided living in a noisy city flat.
I accepted the island job, but I still moved into a noisy city flat.
I am planning to accept the island job so I will avoid a noisy city flat.
explanation_ru: I'd have ended up (= I would have ended up) показывает нереальный исход, а hadn't accepted — что говорящий на самом деле согласился на работу на острове.

prompt: Match the halves of the sentences about the morning at the Jakarta zoo.
pairs: If Marina had noticed the loose lock,
she would have closed the cage before breakfast.
The young monkey wouldn't have escaped
if the gate hadn't stayed open.
What would the keepers have done
if the animal had climbed over the outer wall?
If the staff hadn't brought fresh fruit,
they couldn't have tempted it back inside.
explanation_ru: Каждая пара соединяет условие в Past Perfect и результат с would/couldn't have + V3, согласуясь по смыслу, местоимению и порядку слов (утверждение или вопрос).

prompt: Read Fatima's note about her part-time degree in Amman and tap the sentences with a grammar mistake.
sentences: Choosing part-time study in Amman turned out to be the smartest decision of my twenties.
If I would have joined a full-time programme, I wouldn't have kept my morning job at the bank.
My parents were worried at first, but they soon saw how well the evening lectures suited me.
I might have felt exhausted after work if I had chose a flat on the far side of the city.
If I had listened to the people who doubted my plan, I would have missed three great years.

fixes.1: If I had joined a full-time programme, I wouldn't have kept my morning job at the bank.
fixes.3: I might have felt exhausted after work if I had chosen a flat on the far side of the city.

explanation_ru: Во втором предложении лишнее would have после if (нужно had joined), а в четвёртом использована вторая форма глагола вместо третьей (had chosen, а не had chose).

prompt: Put the words in the right order to make a question.
answer: Would life have been busier if I'd chosen a city flat?
accepted_answers: Would life have been busier if I'd chosen a city flat?
Would city life have been busier if I'd chosen a flat?
explanation_ru: В вопросе третьего типа на первое место выходит Would, затем подлежащее и have + V3 (Would life have been busier), а затем условие с if и Past Perfect (if I'd chosen).
